title: Minimum precast concrete cover.
officialText: For structural steel columns protected with precast concrete column covers as shown in Figure 721.5.1 (6)(a), Tables 721.5.1(9) and 721.5.1(10) indicate the thickness of the column covers required for various fire-resistance ratings for typical wide-flange shapes. The thicknesses of concrete given in these tables also apply to structural steel columns larger than those listed.
